Name: Abital, Wife of David
Summary: Wife of David and mother of Shephatiah, born in Hebron.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 3:3: Wife of David and mother of Shephatiah, born in Hebron.
LifeLesson: The mention of Abital in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
